messages:
olivia-sales: quick handoff — NebulaHealth signed a 30d POC today. They want private deploy (VPC) + SSO (SAML) and a connector to their EHR. Trial starts 2026-05-04.
jenna-cs: thanks olivia. can you paste the SSO metadata and confirm whether any PHI will flow?
olivia-sales: SSO metadata attached in email, but here's the SP entity id they sent: urn:nebula:sp. PHI: limited patient IDs in embeddings (they said hashed, but legal asked). also they requested dedicated capacity w/ burst.
sam-ops: quick note — dedicated estimate is ~4x small GPUs for baseline. need region us-east-1 and private networking. provisioning lead time ~2 weeks after infra signoff.
jenna-cs: flagged renewal risk: they asked about SLA and isolation right away. if onboarding slips past day 45 of POC we should escalate to AM for renewal push. assigning owners below.
devon-eng: I can scope the EHR connector. will need sample schema + example export (CSV/JSON). creating ENG ticket.
jenna-cs: created support ticket SUP-1209 for initial infra/provisioning checklist and SSO trouble-shoot. link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/SUP-1209
devon-eng: ENG-4521 created to track EHR connector + data masking. jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-4521. rough ETA for prototype 10 business days after we get sample exports.
olivia-sales: I'll follow up with Nebula to get the sample export and their security contact (they said ops-security@nebula.health).
jenna-cs: owners/next steps: 1) olivia-sales — deliver sample export + SSO metadata by 2026-04-27 2) devon-eng — scope + prototype connector, update ENG-4521 by 2026-05-11 3) sam-ops — provision dedicated pool estimate and share cost by 2026-04-30 4) marta-support-bot — monitor SUP-1209 and escalate if SSO fails on first attempt
marta-support-bot: noted. will post status updates to this thread and ping #eng-oncall if blocked.
jenna-cs: risk rating = medium-high (data sensitivity + private deploy). if any of the first three items slip more than 72h, we flag AM and schedule executive call.
olivia-sales: copying AM (cc @amanda). sending sample export today.
devon-eng: quick technical ask — do we have a masking spec? if not, initial plan: client-side hashing + server-side tokenization. small snippet of masking plan: ```python
def mask_id(raw):
    return sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
```
jenna-cs: that looks fine as a starting point. we'll route legal review but proceed for prototype.
olivia-sales: thanks team. marking owners as accepted. will update when export sent. :thumbsup:
